_note: Least privilege for the API roles (Nov 2, 2026). Shared by redhorse, quiz-game and joy-of-chemistry. Every entry is a call the browser makes with the public key; server routes use the service role. party_games UPDATE, party_players UPDATE, party_answers DELETE and party_scores INSERT are attempted by the party host page but no policy allows them, so row-level security blocks them; the grants are kept so the app behaves exactly as before. prophecies SELECT serves /reveal, /superadmin and /api/prophecy/[id] (public-key client). chemistry_profiles updates are column-limited to the daily usage reset (stories_today, chats_today, usage_reset_date); tier and subscription fields are server-only.
